turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40. Who decided on the zero, Hale, and when?
Owen talks about you in class, by the way.
That's not why I'm here. You entered a mark without calling me. On whose decision?
He's one of the kindest kids I teach. He walked a new student around the building all through September.
Save it. A kind boy with a zero he didn't earn is still a boy with a zero. What do you have?
A kid like that doesn't cheat out of malice. He was overwhelmed. We can both agree on that, right?
You're leading me, and I've done this for twenty years. Nobody in this room has agreed that Owen cheated, and I won't. Show me something with a date on it, or I'm going upstairs.
